rate_to_APPLY_note: Attach this one to a real gap. It is fit on compositions DISJOINT from the fold's evaluation_cth, so applying it to a gap whose CTH sits in that fold uses evidence from other compositions -- the same leakage-safe pattern P2-E4 uses. rank_calibration_held_out is measured ON those same compositions and attaching it to a gap drawn from them would be circular.
rate_to_REPORT_note: Use this to state how well the calibration transfers to unseen compositions. It is the honest quality claim and belongs in reports; it is not the number to hang on an individual gap.
estimand: Among selector-accepted cross-line spans from calibration compositions where this candidate rank exists, the fraction whose intentionally hidden attested middle occurs at that rank. A property of many past comparisons at that rank in this stratum -- never the probability that one particular lost reading is true, and never applicable to same-line gaps.
